purpose: Block new or materially changed Make scenarios from production promotion when cost, reliability, security, semantic ownership, recovery or learning contracts are missing.

rules.require: Generic shared stores such as Interaction Datahub must have explicit positive/negative domain eligibility before code, AI or writes. Generic schema membership is never sufficient domain identity.
Stable dedupe/idempotency/atomic overlap guard must execute before broad source reads, AI/media generation, external research or mutating side effects whenever duplicate execution is possible.
Every scheduled/read-heavy source must declare a hard page/batch/window bound. Unbounded scans are not production-admissible.
Retrieve/project only fields consumed downstream when the connector/API supports projection. If the trigger cannot project, document that limitation and provide a migration or bounded mitigation.
Time-window, approval, due, identity, unchanged/already-complete, domain eligibility and known-policy checks run before expensive API/AI/media/inventory work.
AI step must state the non-deterministic decision it resolves and must consume bounded mission-relevant context rather than full shared/raw records.
New polling requires proof that no event/change-driven path is available and must declare freshness SLA, interval and lookback overlap. Frequency may not be increased merely to clear backlog.
Array query encoding, endpoint semantics and complex JSON mapping are proven in an isolated/no-side-effect probe before production mutation. Do not infer read endpoints from write symmetry.
Material source/trigger migrations run shadow/no-write first. Prove candidate selection/eligibility, then output equivalence on representative protected cases, before cutover.
Production verification covers semantic key/value/type/outcome invariants, not only Make success, HTTP 2xx, schema validity or non-empty output.
429/limit handling must stop, cool down, read back remote state, and permit at most one targeted retry without new evidence.

Material error, recovery, optimization, experiment and contract change must write fingerprint/root cause/fix/evidence/prevention through the shared learning fabric and refresh shared context without recursive/unbounded fan-out.
A change that regresses any protected metric by more than 10% is rejected or rolled back unless the regression is explicitly justified and accepted.

promotion_decision.pass: All block rules satisfied and protected regression evidence green.
promotion_decision.fail: Any required block rule missing, unknown, or red. Promotion must fail closed.
promotion_decision.warning_only: Only explicitly marked non-blocking observations may warn without blocking.
